title: Ball Headband – The Funniest Duel of the Night
descriptionHtml:
Everyone sits on their own couch with their own screen

A cozy Friday night sounds nice on paper – in reality everyone scrolls alone. And before every party the same hunt: a gift that isn't yet another gift card.

Put on the headband – and see what happens

The ball hangs on an elastic string in the middle of your forehead and bounces back in a direction nobody counted on. Whoever wears the band looks silly, everyone else laughs, and two minutes later the whole family is lined up to beat the record. That it happens to sharpen your reflexes is mostly an excuse for the adults.

Features

  • Makes the whole room laugh – whoever misses looks the funniest
  • Everyone can join in right away – adjustable headband, from kids' parties to family dinners
  • The competition starts by itself – count hits in a row and crown a champion
  • Disturbs no one – soft foam ball, no bangs on floors or walls
  • Small to wrap, easy to bring along – fits in your pocket and in the gift bag

Change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
